groundCover.label: Ground Cover
groundCover.hint: Changes the color and texture of the ground in the game and the colors of 2D maps. It does not affect the simulation.

climate.label: Climate
climate.hint: Copies monthly temperature, precipitation, sunlight and weather probabilities from a preset. Edit the details in Climate settings in scenario creation mode.

assetRegion.label: Building and road asset region
assetRegion.hint: Chooses the lineup of building and road appearances. It does not affect the simulation.
